title: Rory and the Velvet Moss Grove
verses:
The stars were all shining high up in the blue,
The grass was all covered in cool evening dew.
Then Rory walked slow through the soft velvet green,
To rest in the quietest place ever seen.

And Tilly sat down by a log in the shade,
While Benny stretched out in the sleepiest glade.
Then Ricky tucked close in a warm leafy heap,
And yawned as he waited for wonderful sleep.

Psittaco hopped down to a blanket of moss,
Where soft silver moonlight was drifting across.
And Nia tucked softly her wings for a rest,
And murmured that this was the spot they loved best.

Then Benny let out a long sigh through his nose,
As restful calm settled from eyelids to toes.
And Tilly snuggled up near a warm cozy stone,
So happy that nobody rested alone.

Then Rory looked round at his dear sleepy crew,
All dreaming beneath the deep night dark and blue.
He cuddled down deep in the grass soft and sweet,
And tucked in his tail and his small tired feet.

The breeze hummed a lullaby quiet and slow,
While soft little stars gave a gentle warm glow.
Now night wrapped the jungle in peacefulness deep,
And Rory and all of them drifted to sleep.
